You are choosing one picture for an illustrated story scene.
Scene: Chinnu the squirrel sits at the edge of a calm lily pond with a bright idea, Grandpa Tortoise resting far away on the other side
Characters and how they must look: Mira the woman: a woman in her thirties with short dark hair, a mustard scarf, a grey coat and a calm, curious expression.
Art style: ink and wash illustration, loose expressive ink lines with soft watery colour washes, light airy composition, gentle bleeding edges, delicate and calm

There are 2 pictures, numbered 1 to 2 in the order given. Pick the picture that best matches the scene, keeps every character on model, looks natural and has no text in it.
Answer with only the number of the best picture.
